pinned_variant: B-D1 (pooled-source adapted, generalizes the paper's own C1+C4->C6). Explicitly named 'DP2Net-adapted (pooled source)' in the old train.py docstring and stated there as 'what enters the DC-PSR D1 main comparison table' -- NOT 'B-S' (native single-source, preserves DP2Net's own SSDG character) and NOT Protocol A (paper-native sanity check, 4-stage labels, C1-only source). Only B-D1 is ported to this repo.

Dropped Protocol-A-only functions (assign_paper_native_4stage, build_sample_manifest, build_windows_cache for the 4-class/2000-per-class manifest) since this repo's formal B8 adapter only uses the Protocol B-D1 unified-window cache. build_unified_windows_cache gained a max_runs param for fast smoke tests (default None = full 315-run universe, same behavior as before). No change to filter/window-extraction math or physical constants.

copied_files.modification: Rewritten to the shared MethodAdapter interface. Algorithm 1's two-stage protocol (pretrain S+F classification, then train G+F with S frozen, MMD-guided) is preserved unchanged, including the exact loss formulas (L_G = L_MSE - alpha*L_MMD, L_task = CE(source)+CE(generated)) and the S+F-only inference path (G is training-time-only per the paper's own Algorithm 1). Removed the old file's resume/checkpoint-per-stage logic (torch.save mid-stage) -- MethodAdapter's base class does not currently support mid-run resume within a single train() call, only whole-cell resume via DONE.flag; flagged as a known limitation below, not silently dropped.

not_copied.reason: Not the official B8 variant for this repo's formal comparison table (see pinned_variant above). Not ported; see old train.py if ever needed for a future paper-fidelity re-check or for reporting DP2Net's native single-source number as a supplementary ablation.

adaptation_notes: Architecture (model.py: S/G/F/mmd_loss) and training hyperparameters (config.yaml) are UNCHANGED from the validated published-baseline reproduction. Only task/seed/path routing and variant selection changed, per task spec section 35. Seed handling: old train.py::run_protocol_b already accepted seed as a proper kwarg for variant B-D1 (verified against the live file, not assumed) -- this adapter wires MethodAdapter's self.seed through via shared/utils/seeding.py::seed_everything(), called immediately before build_model().
known_limitation: The old train.py supported resuming mid-way through Stage 1 or Stage 2 via per-epoch checkpoint files (stage1_checkpoint.pth / stage2_checkpoint.pth). This adapter's train() does not yet implement that intra-cell resume -- MethodAdapter's --resume only skips a (task,seed) cell that already has DONE.flag; a killed mid-training run restarts Stage 1 from epoch 0 on retry. Given pretrain_epochs=gen_epochs=100 and batch_size=64, a full B8 run is not fast (see README time-planning note) -- if this proves painful during the real 9x3x101 sweep, intra-cell checkpointing should be added to shared/runners/method_adapter.py generically (flagged for the parent, not implemented here per scope).
checkpoint_note: Historical combined S+G+F checkpoint size ~264KB. Never committed to git regardless of size -- **/*.pth globally gitignored.
